items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: our saxophonist Mazie Mullins, thought that she would take me out... to a cabaret, with Will Marion

ctx.x: Okay, tell me about that. That's interesting.

Well, we arrived in Chicago and our saxophonist Mazie Mullins, thought that she would take me out, being a kid, you know, to a cabaret, with Will Marion -- Dad Cook, and certain other members, to see,

items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...The orchestra, of course, is under the direction of Will Marion Cook. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: Well, which band were you -- you left right away to go off with Will Marion Cook?
No, I didn't leave right away. I say that I continued, I continued with the band.
